== Related skills ==
* {{skill icon|Agony (PvP)}}

== Notes ==
* This skill creates a [[Spirit of Rejuvenation]].
* Only heals party members below full health, so while your party hasn't started combat, try not to equip [[vampiric]] weapon modifiers.
* This spirit's healing does trigger [[Scourge Healing]].
* At level 15, Rejuvenation does the equivalent of 5 [[pip]]s of [[health regeneration]] for a total of 30 seconds distributed amongst the party members (1 party member under its effect will receive 30 seconds while 3 party members will receive 10 seconds, etc.).
